 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR

ORAL ORDER 3 15-07-2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2.

This application has been filed for quashing the order dated 08.06.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Sherghati, Gaya by which learned Magistrate has taken cognizance against the petitioners in Complaint Case No. 168 of 2022 registered under sections 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. As per prosecution case, complainant purchased a land from the petitioners and paid them Rs.
26,50,000/-.
Complainant asked them to register the land in his name but they always eluded by making excuses.

Further complainant Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.30262 of 2023(3)
dt.15-07-2024 inquired the matter and came to know that the husband of Malti Devi has filed a Title Suit No. 886/2014 against the accused persons that he has right, title and interest over the said land and Malti Devi has ever executed any kind of sale deed in their favour.

sentences.text: The matter has been settled in mediation.

The agreement of mediation is at Page-64 which reads as follows:-
"That after great persuasion offered to pay Rs. 19,50,000/- (Rupees Nineteen Lakh Fifty Thousand) which was taken from Opposite Party no. 2 and the opposite party no. 2 accepted the amount in Mediation Centre, Patna High Court, Patna and both parties are ready to compromise the case.

That the petitioner has paid Rs. 10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakh) on 12.05.2023 through Demand Draft No. 154925, dated 01.07.2023 and the remaining amount of Rs. 4,50,000/- (Rupees Four Lakh Fifty Thousand) is being paid vide Demand Draft No. 154931 dated 25.07.2023.
The opposite party no. 2
received the aforesaid all demand drafts in presence Mediator and both ld. Advocates and also present both the parties."
5. In view of the agreement, the prosecution of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.30262 of 2023(3) dt.15-07-2024 petitioner shall not continue.
6. In view thereof, this application is allowed.
7. The order dated 08.06.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Sherghati, Gaya by which learned Magistrate has taken cognizance against the petitioners in Complaint Case No. 168 of 2022.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) Ranjeet/-
